roi_volume.label: ROI volume
roi_volume.meaning: Volume of one brain region from a partial-volume mask (sum of fractions x voxel volume).

NAA_Cr.label: NAA/Cr
NAA_Cr.meaning: Ratio of the NAA peak (2.01 ppm) to the creatine peak (3.03 ppm) in the frontal voxel.

Cho_Cr.label: Cho/Cr
Cho_Cr.meaning: Ratio of the choline peak (3.20 ppm) to the creatine peak (3.03 ppm) in the frontal voxel.
